note: Preview-only palettes. Claimed/restored tuning is unchanged. Unclaimed structures start from their shipping weathered colours and sludge, with only a 10% palette/desaturation/lightness nudge.

treatment.source: Shipping unclaimed renderer, including floor textures and sludge; colours above are its original pre-treatment values.
treatment.note: A 10% palette/desaturation/lightness nudge after rendering. Preserve original green weathering, blob geometry, density, alpha and shadow contrast. Dark outlines stay intact.

contrastPolicy.rule: Keep floors light and desaturated. Wall and tower bodies stay darker, with deep outlines, distinct shadow planes and bright top surfaces; do not wash out the whole object.
contrastPolicy.benchmark: assets/Objects/trunk.png, closed frame 0: original dark edge / shaded body / lit top contrast.
